instruction: Pick the chicken drumstick and cucumber from their plates and place them in the bowl. Then put the bowl in the fridge.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: at least one of the two food items lies in the bowl and the gripper is no longer touching it.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: no food item is in the bowl yet (still on its plate, held, or dropped elsewhere).

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both food items lie in the bowl and the gripper is not touching them.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: only one food item is in the bowl, or the gripper is still holding the second one.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both food items are in the bowl, the bowl stands on a shelf inside the fridge, and the gripper has moved away from the bowl (about 25 cm or more).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the bowl is still on the counter, still held, not on a fridge shelf, a food item fell out, or the gripper is still at the bowl.
